title: Microsoft Power Apps Developer
description:
Senior Microsoft Power Platform / Power Apps Developer
 



 Company: Techworkstalent Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Location: Chennai / Remote – India
 



 Work Mode: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 4–8 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 About Techworkstalent
 



 Techworkstalent is an technology solutions company delivering enterprise application development, automation, CRM, low\-code/no\-code and digital transformation solutions to customers in India and international markets.
 



 We are expanding our Microsoft Power Platform capability and are looking for an experienced Power Apps Developer who can work on enterprise\-grade applications involving Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and AI/Copilot capabilities.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Power Apps / Power Platform Developer who can translate business requirements into scalable enterprise applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
 



 The candidate will work closely with the Project/Delivery Lead, Solution Architect, Dataverse developers, AI/Copilot developers and QA team to design, develop, test and deploy business applications.
 



 This is a hands\-on development role and requires strong experience in Canvas Apps, Model\-Driven Apps, Dataverse and Power Automate, along with the ability to understand enterprise business processes and integration requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Power Apps Development
 


* Design and develop enterprise\-grade Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps.
* Build responsive, user\-friendly interfaces based on business requirements.
* Develop reusable components and application frameworks.
* Implement complex business logic and workflows.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability and maintainability.



 Dataverse
 


* Work extensively with Microsoft Dataverse as the application's system of record.
* Design tables, relationships, columns, views, forms and business rules.
* Implement security roles and appropriate access controls.
* Work with Dataverse APIs and integrations where required.
* Optimize data models and application performance.



 Power Automate \& Automation
 


* Design and develop Power Automate cloud flows.
* Automate business processes, notifications, approvals and integrations.
* Handle error management, exception handling and monitoring.
* Integrate Power Platform applications with external systems and APIs.



 Integration
 


* Integrate Power Apps with:
* REST APIs
* Microsoft 365
* SharePoint
* SQL databases
* External business applications
* Other enterprise systems
* Understand authentication mechanisms such as OAuth/API authentication.
* Work with solution architects to implement scalable integration patterns.



 AI / Copilot Collaboration
 


* Work with the AI/Copilot team to integrate AI\-driven capabilities into Power Platform applications.
* Support integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio where required.
* Understand how AI agents interact with Dataverse and enterprise data.
* Implement application components required to expose data and business processes to AI agents.



 Testing \& Deployment
 


* Perform unit testing and developer\-level functional testing.
* Support QA teams during system and UAT testing.
* Troubleshoot defects and production issues.
* Participate in deployment and release activities.
* Follow Power Platform Solutions, ALM and environment management best practices.



 Documentation
 


* Prepare technical documentation for applications and integrations.
* Document configuration, workflows, data models and deployment processes.
* Maintain development standards and reusable technical assets.



 Required Technical Skills
 



 Must Have
 


* 4\+ years of experience in Microsoft Power Platform development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power Apps.
* Strong experience with Canvas Apps.
* Experience with Model\-Driven Apps.
* Strong Dataverse experience.
* Strong Power Automate experience.
* Experience with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Understanding of Power Platform security and permissions.
* Experience with Power Platform Solutions and deployment.
* Good understanding of relational database concepts.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.



 Good to Have
 


* Power Pages.
* Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Power BI.
* Azure Functions / Azure services.
* JavaScript.
* TypeScript.
* C\# / .NET.
* SQL Server.
* SharePoint Online.
* Microsoft Graph API.
* Power Platform ALM / DevOps.
* Git / Azure DevOps.
* Experience building AI\-enabled business applications.



 Preferred Certifications
 



 One or more of the following would be an advantage:
 


* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL\-400\)
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL\-200\)
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform App Maker
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI / Azure Fundamentals



 Certifications are preferred but strong hands\-on project experience will be considered more important.
 



 Experience Profile
 



 We are particularly interested in candidates who have:
 


* Delivered production Power Platform applications.
* Worked on enterprise implementations rather than only internal/demo applications.
* Experience working with Solution Architects and business stakeholders.
* Experience taking applications from requirements → design → development → testing → deployment → hypercare.
* Experience handling complex Dataverse data models.
* Experience integrating Power Apps with external systems.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.



 Ideal Candidate
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who can operate beyond simply building screens in Power Apps.
 



 You should be able to understand a business requirement, participate in solution discussions, design the appropriate Power Platform implementation, develop the application, troubleshoot issues and work with the wider project team through deployment.
 



 Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills are therefore important.
 



 What We Offer
 


* Opportunity to work on international enterprise projects.
* Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform and AI\-driven business applications.
* Opportunity to work with Solution Architects and senior technology leaders.
* Exposure to enterprise application architecture and digital transformation.
* Opportunity to grow into Power Platform Technical Lead / Solution Architect roles.
* Hands\-on experience across Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and Copilot/AI.



 Keywords for Recruitment Search
 



 Power Apps Developer, Microsoft Power Platform Developer, Power Platform Developer, Canvas Apps Developer, Model Driven Apps Developer, Dataverse Developer, Power Automate Developer, Power Platform Consultant, Microsoft Power Platform Consultant, Copilot Studio, Power Platform ALM, Power Platform Technical Lead.

title: Lead Engineer, Software
description:
Req ID: 128274
   

  

 Remote Position: No
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Individual Contributor to join our team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our cutting\-edge Network Operating System (NOS), from initial bring\-up on new hardware platforms to the development and sustenance of advanced networking features. You will be a hands\-on technical expert, working on the core of our networking stack and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-performance, robust, and scalable solutions for our customers.
   

  

 Detailed Description
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform Bring\-up \& System Features: Lead the bring\-up of our NOS on new hardware platforms, including the development and integration of Linux device drivers. Ensure system\-level features such as High Availability (HA) and Stacking are robust and performant.
* NOS Development \& Sustenance: Design, develop, and maintain software for our NOS, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability. This includes troubleshooting and resolving complex issues in the field.
* Network Stack Development: Drive the development of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols. That may need expertise in routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP, as well as other key technologies like MPLS, VXLAN, and QoS. (May not be all the protocols mentioned here)
* Management \& Control Plane: Implement and sustain management interfaces and protocols, including SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, REST, CLI, gNMI, and gRPC, to enable seamless integration with network management systems. (May not be all the protocols mentioned here)
* ASIC/NPU Integration: Leverage your strong experience with Broadcom's XGS/DNX family of devices to develop and optimize software for high\-performance packet forwarding. Experience with Marvell's Innovium/Prestera family is a plus.
* Collaborative Teamwork: Work closely with other engineering teams, QA, and customer\-facing teams to ensure the successful delivery and deployment of our products.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

* Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience as an Individual Contributor in a networking domain.
* Programming Languages: Rich, hands\-on experience with C, C\+\+, Python, and GoLang.
* Networking Expertise:
* In\-depth knowledge of L2/L3 networking protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP).
* Proven experience with MPLS, VXLAN, and QoS.
* Management Protocols: Strong understanding and practical experience with network management protocols and APIs (SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, REST, gNMI, gRPC).
* ASICs: Solid working experience with network processor units (NPUs) from Broadcom (XGS/DNX family).
* NOS Experience: Prior experience in Network Operating System (NOS) development or sustenance is essential. Experience with SONiC NOS is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills:
* Excellent inter\-working and collaboration skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple functional teams and customer\-facing organizations.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
* Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
* Occasional travel may be required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 6\+ years


 Typical Education
   

  

 Bachelor degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Educational Requirements may vary by Geography
   

  

 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
   

  

 At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world’s best brands. Through our recognized customer\-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development – from drawing board to full\-scale production and after\-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next\-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40\+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers.
   

  

 Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
   

  

 Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

title: Technical Lead - GISOCC Office IS
description:
**Responsibilities**
****Pure Architecture \& Low\-Level Design (LLD)****
* Layered Microservices Design: Architect and evolve highly scalable, decoupled, and layered microservices architectures using Java ecosystem standards.
* Database \& Framework Architecture: Design robust, high\-performance database schemas (SQL/NoSQL). Establish standard, language\-agnostic foundational frameworks to streamline development across disparate teams.
* Low\-Level Design (LLD): Translate high\-level business requirements into clean, maintainable low\-level technical designs, class diagrams, and execution blueprints.
* Engineering Excellence \& CI/CD
* Automated Code Governance: Set up automated tool\-based code review workflows (e.g., SonarQube) to maintain high code quality and consistency.
* Testing \& CI/CD Pipelines: Enforce comprehensive Unit Testing cultures and design/optimize continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for seamless delivery.
* Deprecation Management: Establish automated notification systems for language, library, and framework deprecations to proactively mitigate technical debt.
* Non\-Functional Testing (NFT) \& Security
* Security \& Compliance: Drive vulnerability management and license compliance, ensuring software/language deprecations and security flaws are proactively caught using tools like Black Duck.
* Standardized Exception Handling: Define and implement enterprise\-grade, generic exception\-handling frameworks across platforms to ensure system resilience and consistent error tracking.
* Observability: Architect platform\-specific monitoring, logging, and control mechanisms (APM tools) to ensure proactive system health checks and alerting.
* Product, AI Innovation \& Communication

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).

description:
****Company Overview****
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

****Job Description/Preferred Qualifications****
 Job Description/Preferred Qualifications
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Candidate should have Doctorate/Master's degree in either of Physics, Engineering Physics, Engineering Design, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Materials and Metallurgical Engineering.
   

  

 Knowledge in instrumentation, signal processing and optical/electro\-optical systems such as electron microscopes is preferred.
   

  

 Experience with Vacuum Systems, Electron Optics, and High Voltage for scanning electron microscopes or equivalent a plus.
   

  

 Hands\-on experiences in machine control and/or scientific data analysis is highly desired.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated an ability in setting\-up experiments, modelling and data analysis, solving complex technical problems.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated proficiency in scripting language (MATLAB, Python, others) for scientific data collection \& analysis.
   

  

 Finally, the candidate must have excellent communication, interpersonal skills and ability to create effective technical presentations.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Work within the engineering team on designing new or improving designs of existing electron\-beam imaging products for the semiconductor equipment market.
   

  

 The product subsystems include light optics, electron optics, imaging, detectors, HV electronics, vacuum systems, wafer transfer systems, detection and classification algorithms, machine control and UI software.
   

  

 The candidate is expected to gain a detailed functional understanding of the entire product, act independently, devise and drive innovative analyses and solutions for complex problems.
   

  

 Activities will include development of new designs by specifying SW / Algo / HW requirements followed by characterization, product integration and maintenance.
   

  

 Candidate is expected to be involved in on\-site customer support in Taiwan, Korea, Singapore, etc.
   

  

 For necessary training, candidate would be trained at our Singapore and US offices. The overall travel load is between 75\-90%
   

  

****Minimum Qualifications****
 Dual Degree with 2 years relevant experience or Doctorate
   

  

 (Mech, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering Design, Engineering Physics)

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive
 **Senior SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) Functional Consultant** 
 to serve as a subject matter expert in Direct Procurement within the automotive/manufacturing domain. This role will lead the end\-to\-end requisition\-to\-order (RTO) stream, translating complex manufacturing supply chain needs into robust, scalable SAP S/4HANA and Fiori configurations.
   

  

*The Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant will drive activities across the full implementation lifecycle:*
* Requirements Engineering \& Business Analysis: Lead discovery workshops, conduct Fit/Gap analyses between standard S/4HANA capabilities and Ford's Direct Procurement processes, and document user stories, Epics, and functional requirements.
* Functional Design \& Architecture: Author comprehensive Functional Design Documents (FDDs) for direct material procurement workflows, including Scheduling Agreements (LP/LPA), Purchase Orders, Directed Tier\-2 sourcing, Subcontracting, and Intercompany stock transfers.
* Technical Collaboration \& Build Oversight: Partner with technical software engineering teams (ABAP, SAP Fiori / UI5, Google Cloud Platform / PCF integration middleware) to translate functional requirements into high\-quality technical deliverables; review Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and code handoffs.
* Legacy Integration \& Ecosystem Interoperability: Design and validate integration points between SAP S/4HANA MM and Ford's legacy non\-SAP manufacturing, planning, bill of materials (BOM), and warehouse systems, as well as SAP Ariba (Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration).
* End\-to\-End Testing \& Defect Resolution: Architect and execute test strategies covering Functional Unit Testing (FUT), System Integration Testing (SIT), Security/Authorization validation, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT); drive root\-cause analysis and defect triage.
* Data Migration \& Cutover Readiness: Support master data profiling, cleansing, field mapping, and validation for Direct Procurement data entities (Material Masters, Business Partners/Vendors, Info Records, Source Lists, Quota Arrangements). Assist in cutover simulation and go\-live deployment.
* Process Governance \& SME Roadmap: Act as Direct Procurement SME to define global template design standards for Ford's automotive manufacturing plants, mitigating localized custom code and ensuring alignment with Clean Core principles.
* Change Enablement \& Post Go\-Live Support: Develop end\-user training materials, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deliver hypercare and steady\-state stabilization across global deployment waves.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Core SAP S/4HANA MM Expertise: Deep functional and configuration knowledge of Direct Material Requisitioning, Automated PO Generation, Scheduling Agreements with Release Documentation (FRC/JIT delivery schedules), Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS), Subcontracting, Consignment, and Intercompany STO.
* Automotive / Manufacturing Direct Procurement: Comprehensive grasp of automotive supply chain dynamics, plant\-floor logistics interfaces, JIT/JIS procurement, directed component tiers (Tier\-1 / Directed Tier\-2 flows), and plant inventory valuation.
* Integration Knowledge: Strong cross\-module integration understanding across SAP MM\-PP (MRP / Material Requirements Planning), MM\-SD/LE (Logistics Execution / Inbound Deliveries), MM\-FI/CO (Account Determination, GR/IR clearing, Product Costing), and MM\-QM (Quality Inspection / Goods Receipt).
* Modern SAP Ecosystem: Proficiency with SAP Fiori role\-based apps, SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration (SCC), B2B EDI communication (EDIFACT/ANSI X12 via IDocs, APIs, OData services), and SAP Activate agile delivery methodology.
* Total Professional Experience: 7 to 10 years of overall IT / enterprise application implementation experience.
* SAP Functional MM Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands\-on functional design, configuration, and testing experience in SAP MM.
* Full Lifecycle Implementations: Demonstrated participation in at least 1–2 full lifecycle implementations of SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield, Brownfield, or Central Finance/iERP deployment) including Fiori interface rollout.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mechanical/Industrial Engineering, Business Information Technology, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Leadership \& Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional global teams (IT, business stakeholders, system integrators), facilitate requirements workshops, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical leaders.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical, diagnostic, and root\-cause analysis mindset with meticulous attention to detail.

title: Engineer - Software
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Software Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in software design, development, and maintenance of enterprise\-grade applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong logical and analytical thinking, excellent programming skills, and a passion for building high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

 The candidate will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and support software products throughout the product development lifecycle. This role requires strong technical ownership, problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to contribute effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.
   

  

 Success in this position requires effective collaboration, a strong drive to achieve project objectives, and the ability to learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and processes. Experience in media\-related applications, video streaming, surveillance systems, or Video Management Systems (VMS) will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain software applications to meet business and customer requirements.
* Develop robust, reusable, and maintainable automation solutions using C\# .NET.
* Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into robust software solutions.
* Participate in software architecture, design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision\-making.
* Develop scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance applications following software engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

* Contribute to automation initiatives.
* Take technical ownership of assigned modules and ensure successful delivery.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Design, develop, and maintain software applications using .NET Framework / .NET Core

* Work on video streaming, processing, and real\-time data handling
* Integrate third\-party SDKs and multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer
* Develop and maintain interop layers between .NET applications and native C\+\+ libraries using C\+\+/CLI
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including hardware, firmware, and QA teams
* Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical documentation
* Support product enhancements, bug fixes, and sustaining engineering activities
* Ensure compliance with performance, scalability, and security standards.


**Qualifications**
* BE / B.Tech \- CSE or IT.

**Skills**
* Strong experience in .NET Framework / .NET Core
* Proficiency in C\# programming

* Knowledge of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTP, ONVIF preferred)

description:
**Description**
 We invite you to be part of a high\-impact team that is shaping the future of pricing at Amazon. The Digital Pricing team is at the forefront of leveraging AI and machine learning to compute millions of prices across our digital products. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help design and build the next generation of our AI\-powered pricing systems.
   

  

 As a SDE, You'll will develop next generation pricing systems that process millions of prices daily. Our platform combines pricing strategies with advanced AI models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI and custom neural networks, to make real\-time pricing decisions that directly impact our business and customers.
   

  

 Joining the Digital Pricing team means taking on a role where technical expertise meets real\-world impact. From the outset, you’ll work with advanced AI technologies to develop solutions that power pricing across Amazon’s extensive digital products. This team is not only building innovative pricing systems—but also redefining how millions of customers experience Amazon’s digital products.
   

  

 The technical challenges you'll tackle are unique. You'll work with advanced AWS infrastructure, design distributed systems at massive scale, and implement AI solutions that directly impact Amazon's digital business. Whether you're optimising model performance, or developing new pricing systems, you'll have the resources and support to succeed.
   

  

 By joining Digital Pricing, you're not just changing teams – you're accelerating your career while solving complex challenges that matter. We're committed to helping you become the best engineer you can be, all while working on systems that shape Amazon's future.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Your growth matters to us. You will have a structured path to achieve your career aspirations, backed by dedicated mentorship from senior technical leaders. You'll have access to specialised AI/ML training programs, conference opportunities, and innovation time to explore new technologies. Our engineers regularly present their innovations, and work to senior leadership. Our team's culture emphasises both individual growth and collective success.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS or cloud technologies
* Understanding of AI model optimisation techniques
* Experience with large language models (LLMs)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**

* Define corporate wide security and privacy requirements, controls, and standards.
* Define corporate wide Secure Coding, third\-party, deployment policies \& other architecture\-related standards.
* Define required training content.
* Define paved roads/security and privacy\-by\-design patterns and libraries.
* Lead development of AI\-enabled PSP Architecture capabilities: define use cases, requirements, and success criteria.
* Own the threat modeling framework and quality bars.
* Run/approve security \& privacy architecture reviews.
* Lead audit/assessment planning, evidence of expectations, and defensibility.
* Responsible for tooling selection and integration related to security \& privacy architecture domain.
* Architect for compliance, analyze new regulations and standards to identify gaps in the platform's capabilities, standards, and controls.
* Assess New Acquisitions Architecture and contribute to due diligence on a needed basis.


**Primary Duties:**
 These define the broader responsibilities and areas of ownership within the role
   

  

* Provide recommendations for risk acceptance and exception requests.
* Provide input on tooling strategy and integration guidance for non\-architecture related domains.
* Provide guidance on security requirements for supply chain tooling, pipeline architecture, and associated standards.
* Validate that platform architecture enables enforcement of PSP security controls.

* Provide guidance on true risk vs noise for security tool outputs and penetration tests.

* Working knowledge of threat modeling principles.
* Working Knowledge of security standards (OWASP, ISO, NIST, ...).

* Experience using security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, Vulnerability Scanners, Secret Scanners).
* Hands\-on experience in at least one, preferably more, of these application domains:
+ Embedded device Security
+ Mobile security
+ Web \& API security
+ Desktop security.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud infrastructure, Supply Chain, and deployment Security
* Experience with Agile/SAFe Methodology
* Experience with usage of AI tools in the context of a security program.


**Education And/or Experience**
* Master's Degree, computer science, or similar qualifications.
* At least 3 years in software/product security, application security, or security architecture
* At least 7 years of hands\-on software engineering / QA / DevOps earlier in career (or equivalent).
* At least one security or privacy certification (CISSP, CIPT, CSSLP, CEH, ...) is a plus.
* Proven ownership of at least one of: threat modeling program, secure design review governance, audit evidence management, security tooling strategy, penetration testing program or similar.


**Soft Skills**

* Like training and knowledge\-sharing, with a strong motivation to ensure the security program is successfully implemented by the teams.
* Highly adaptable and approachable, fostering collaboration and open communication.
* Ability to tailor your communication to different audiences such as product owners, development teams, architects, and other high\-level users.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to engage effectively with development teams and Continuous learning mindset.

If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.

* Integrity: You are results\-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.


 This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
   

  

 HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities

* Exit Modules Implementation\- Work with ABAP developers to create and assign user exits (e.g. ZDMEE\_EXIT\_TEMPLATE\_ABA) for complex logic that cannot be achieved via standard configuration.
* PMW Configuration\- Configure Payment Medium Workbench (OBPM1 OBPM2 OBPM3 OBPM4\) to link payment methods to DMEE formats.
* Testing \& Troubleshooting\- Perform unit testing troubleshoot payment file errors using DMEE trace tools and assist in User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* S/4HANA Migration\- Upgrade traditional RFFO\* programs to modern DMEEX/PMW structures.


**Technical Skills Required**

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Job Title: Analyst \- PowerBI Developer

**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to turn complex commercial data into clear decisions that accelerate access to life\-changing medicines? Join our Chennai\-based reporting and analytics team to engineer enterprise\-grade Power BI solutions that scale across dozens of markets and drive faster, smarter decisions for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
   

  

 Here you will own impactful solutions end\-to\-end, from requirements discovery to production support, translating real\-world objectives into robust, secure, and high\-performing data products. You will contribute to setting engineering standards, optimise semantic models, and advance automation and reuse so our delivery teams move with pace and consistency. Do you thrive in fast paced, high\-performing teams and enjoy mentoring others while improving the standard r on quality?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Solution Ownership: Lead the design, development, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, high\-performing Power BI solutions that turn commercial and omnichannel data into actionable insight.
* Semantic Modelling and Performance: Build and optimise star\-schema models, calculations, and DAX to deliver fast, reliable analytics at enterprise scale.
* Engineering Standards and Reuse: Define and promote standards, templates, and automation to increase consistency, reduce cycle time, and improve maintainability across reports and models.
* Data Quality and Governance: Ensure accuracy, accessibility, and actionability through rigorous source\-to\-report reconciliation, row\-level security, lineage tracking, and regulated dissemination procedures.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to business users, analysts, data engineers, governance teams, and delivery partners, translating objectives into technical designs with clear trade\-offs.
* Mentoring and Reviews: Coach developers, lead design and code reviews, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Operational Excellence: Manage delivery workflows, gateways, and refresh strategies; diagnose and resolve issues related to reports, models, and security throughout the entire flow to keep solutions reliable.
* Agile Delivery: Estimate work, manage dependencies and risks, run UAT, and deliver several projects simultaneously in Agile or Scrum environments.
* Omnichannel Insight Enablement: Interpret campaign and channel metrics to generate insights that improve customer engagement and commercial impact across markets.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 4\- 6 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data management, with at least 4years of hands\-on Power BI solution delivery.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and row\-level security.
* Expertise in DAX, Power Query, dimensional modelling, star schemas, calculation design, and performance optimisation for large or complex data models.
* Strong SQL skills and experience integrating data from relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, files, and enterprise applications.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot report, model, refresh, gateway, security, and data\-quality issues across the end\-to\-end reporting flow.
* Experience with requirements elicitation, technical design, estimation, documentation, testing, source\-to\-report reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and production support.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, information security, access controls, data lineage, quality management, and controlled release practices.
* Proven experience leading technical discussions, reviewing builds and code, mentoring developers, and influencing collaborators without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, prioritisation, and communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience delivering multiple initiatives in parallel within Agile or Scrum teams, including risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge of omnichannel, commercial, or digital marketing analytics and experience translating campaign and channel metrics into actionable insights.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, particularly commercial or omnichannel reporting.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, source control, CI/CD, Power Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and automation.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or a relevant Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Agile delivery, technical documentation, and structured knowledge transfer.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Here your technical craft directly supports our purpose to improve patients’ lives, as you partner with diverse experts to build data products that power decisions across the enterprise. description:

 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.

Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. * Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.

* Excellent debugging, analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a broad audience and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

* Experience writing unit, integration, and performance tests.
* Contributions to Open Source projects are a plus.

 Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud\-based applications that support high\-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in
 **Chennai, India**

 **hybrid** 
 work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the
 **Manager, Engineering** 
 .

 Our Collector R\&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency.
   

  

 These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.
   

  

 As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service\-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. * Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and development practices across the team.
* Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies.

title: Converter Software Engineer - Specialist
description:
**Vestas is well\-known in wind technology and actively contributes to its development. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Power \> Power Controls \> Converter Control Framework**
 The Converter Control department plays a key role in maintaining Vestas' leadership in sustainable energy. Our team develops, maintains, and assures the quality of converter control functionalities for all Vestas turbine families, while ensuring full compliance with global grid code requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our Converter Control Department, developing next\-generation control platforms for utility\-scale wind turbines.
   

  

 You will play a key role in designing and implementing software that controls high\-power converters, enabling reliable and efficient renewable energy generation. Working closely with control engineers, system architects, platform teams, and test engineers, you will help translate advanced control concepts into robust, production\-ready embedded solutions.
   

  

 This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex real\-time challenges, helping guide technical decisions, and mentoring colleagues while remaining directly involved in software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop embedded software for converter control systems
* Contribute to software architecture and long\-term platform evolution
* Ensure software quality, maintainability, and scalability across multiple product generations
* Review designs and code to ensure adherence to engineering standards
* Develop and maintain real\-time embedded applications in C/C\+\+
* Implement control\-oriented software running on DSPs, microcontrollers, or industrial embedded platforms
* Optimize software performance, determinism, memory usage, and execution time
* Debug complex issues across software, hardware, and system interfaces
* Support system integration, validation, and commissioning activities while developing automated tests and verification strategies
* Contribute to SIL, HIL, and system\-level validation activities while analyzing field issues and supporting root\-cause investigations


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Embedded Software / Electronics / Similar specialization
* 10 \+ years of experience with embedded software development environments
* Good understanding of software configuration management and version control
* Proficiency with industry tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Knowledge of software integration and release processes
* Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Skilled at diagnosing issues and developing practical solutions


**Competencies**
* Ability to work on their own through complex technical problems
* Experience working with remote, multi\-location teams
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Results\-oriented, receptive to different perspectives, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment
* Mentors junior and mid\-level engineers
* Shares best practices in embedded development and software engineering
* Supports continuous improvement in development processes and tools


**What We Offer**
 We offer you a job in a truly global and collaborative organization with great opportunities for cross\-disciplinary and personal development, where emphasis is placed on the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will benefit from a collaborative, professional atmosphere supported by great technical skill and an inspiring culture. You will be directly involved in facilitating the development of a core product and service, which is of utmost importance to our customers.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary workplace will be Vestas India, Chennai.
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 15th October 2026\.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.
