title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

description:
Join us as an Environment Analyst
   

  

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist environment managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
* You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, and have the opportunity to work with a range of stakeholders across the bank

 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for an Environment Analyst to enable the successful implementation of platform change and deliver customer value by assisting environment managers to deliver complex and critical environment related activities. You’ll help create stories and features for the domain backlog to enable a continual progression of changes and look for ways to improve efficiency, resilience, reliability, quality and manual inconsistency by increasing the use of automation and virtualisation.

* Working with a range of stakeholders across the bank and third party suppliers to make sure that platform environments are optimised

 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth.  Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Senior PKI Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise\-grade Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services with a strong focus on Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) and Active Directory (AD) integration. Handson implementation and integration knowledge of certificate lifecycle management, CA hierarchy governance, enrollment automation, HSM\-backed key protection, CA backup restore, migration and integration with platforms such as Windows Server, Linux, network/security devices, cloud providers, MDM/EPP, and zero\-trust tooling. Subject matter expert for cryptographic standards, certificate\-based authentication, and PKI security controls across the organization.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This job is responsible for developing and delivering complex requirements to accomplish business goals. Key responsibilities of the job include ensuring that software is developed to meet functional, non\-functional and compliance requirements, and solutions are well designed with maintainability/ease of integration and testing built\-in from the outset. Job expectations include a strong knowledge of development and testing practices common to the industry and design and architectural patterns.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build from scratch scalable certificate lifecycle automation solutions (provisioning, renewal, revocation) using Venafi TPP and custom\-developed tooling.
* Develop robust, reusable code (PowerShell, C\#, or similar) to automate complex certificate workflows, system integrations, and backend processes.
* Architect and implement API\-driven automation frameworks leveraging Venafi APIs and enterprise integrations.
* Replace manual or ad hoc processes with fully automated, self\-service solutions aligned to engineering best practices.
* Own the end\-to\-end design, development, and deployment of automation patterns, including error handling, observability, and resiliency.
* Lead the development of standardized automation pipelines and reusable components for enterprise adoption.
* Perform Venafi platform upgrades, patching, and enhancements with a focus on automation, repeatability, and minimal manual intervention.
* Collaborate with DevOps, IAM, Engineering, and Operations teams to embed automation into application onboarding and CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across Windows Server, RHEL/Unix, and distributed environments.
* Drive technical decisions and champion an automation\-first, engineering\-led approach across teams.
* Operate independently with a high degree of ownership, proactively identifying opportunities to engineer solutions rather than apply manual fixes.


**Requirements**
**Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field**
 Certifications If Any : NA
   

  

**Experience Range : 5\+ years**
**Foundational Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience in PKI engineering and certificate lifecycle management.
* Proficient in the ability to design and build custom automation solutions from scratch, not just modify or maintain existing scripts or tools.
* Strong expertise in software development and scripting (PowerShell, C\#, or similar) with a focus on clean, maintainable, production\-quality code.
* Deep understanding of encryption technologies (PKI, TLS, symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, certificate authorities).
* Hands\-on experience building API integrations and automation frameworks, preferably with Venafi APIs.
* Experience integrating certificate automation into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code workflows.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, RHEL/Linux, IIS, and networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, SSH).
* Experience with Venafi TPP, TLS Protect, or similar enterprise certificate management platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex problems into automated, scalable engineering solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical designs and influence adoption.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Self\-starter mindset with high curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguity.


**Desired Skills**

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer / architect you will be responsible for creating a technical strategy and coordinating the designs for meeting the needs of Toast’s largest restaurant brands. You will partner with Product Managers to develop the technology roadmap that enables enterprise customers to leverage the power of Toast. You will also work closely with technical leaders and implementation teams across the organization to deliver robust, scalable solutions with integrations to customers’ external systems. While the role is primarily internally\-facing, it requires infrequent interactions with enterprise customers, listening to their requirements and providing expert guidance as they deploy Toast.
   

  

 If you’re a technical leader or a solutions architect, experienced with enterprise SaaS, passionate about customer value, and a great collaborator, read on!
   

  

**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**
* Lead the evolution of Toast’s backend architecture, frameworks, and data models with a strong focus on delivery efficiency, system scalability, and resilience.
* Design and build the next generation of accounting and financial systems using Java, Kotlin, DynamoDB, Pulsar, GraphQL, Big Data tools, and more.
* Define and implement scalable engineering practices, delivery frameworks, and coding standards that raise the technical bar across the org.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, UX, QA, and multiple engineering teams to deliver robust, customer\-facing solutions.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across business units, aligning technology strategies with key company objectives.
* Champion data\-driven decision making by developing strategies and prioritizing initiatives with high impact on user and business outcomes.
* Mentor and grow engineers across levels, promoting a culture of inclusivity, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
* Guide and influence the broader technical roadmap and architecture strategy for Toast.
* Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building \- contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team


**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**
* 12\+ years of experience designing and delivering complex, scalable backend systems.
* Proven technical leadership on mission\-critical projects, with the ability to influence across multiple teams.
* Strong experience building distributed, event\-driven architectures and microservices in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or similar OOP languages.
* Deep understanding of data architecture and schema design; experience with DynamoDB is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong knowledge of modern database systems (Postgres, SQL Server, DynamoDB).
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, delivering value continuously.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to break down complexity and drive solutions that scale.
* A passion for building impactful products with a customer\-first mindset.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills—respectful, empathetic, humble, and inclusive.
* A growth mindset with a desire to constantly learn and uplift others.
* Comfortable balancing velocity with platform stability and long\-term architecture goals.
* Comfortable using AI\-powered engineering tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, and technical decision\-making, with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated solutions.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating AI into the software development lifecycle to improve engineering effectiveness, and the ability to champion best practices for responsible, secure, and high\-impact AI adoption across engineering teams.


**AI at Toast**
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast\-benefits.
   

  

**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note\-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real\-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai\-in\-hiring
   

  

**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
 We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in\-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in\-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations\-toast
   

  

**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: HCL WebSphere Commerce Developer
description:
Design, develop (code), test, and debug applications on HD Supply’s B2B eCommerce platform. Provide ready\-to\-serve experience and development subject\-matter expertise across the HCL Commerce / WebSphere Commerce (WCS) v8 storefront and the adjacent Next.js and Spring Boot surfaces that now share customer traffic with it. Maintain, enhance, and deliver solutions for commerce applications. Assist team members and project leads in day\-to\-day project work during dual\-run (legacy commerce engine \+ modern storefront).
 



  





**Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities** 



* Design and develop application components in an Agile environment — WCS storefront and business logic, Java/Spring Boot services, and Next.js / React storefront work as assigned.
* Participate in gathering requirements, documenting and designing HCL Commerce / WCS functionality and related enhancements. Support application integration testing, integration development, data conversion, and cut\-over activities.
* Design, develop, and implement multi\-tier commerce applications (web and backend) to support B2B business requirements, including punchout and other customer purchasing\-system channels where those flows still run on Commerce.
* Create and review designs; identify re\-usability, performance issues, and best practices for Commerce, REST/SOAP services, and Java.
* Support the full life cycle of storefront pages, store data, store business logic, customization of WebSphere / HCL Commerce tools, and integration with back\-end systems (including services that sit in front of or beside Commerce).
* Implement Java\-based solutions for public\-facing B2B websites based on business requirements; extend or consume Spring Boot APIs that wrap or replace Commerce capabilities as pages move off WCS.
* Contribute to Next.js / React storefront work (pages, data fetching, integration with Commerce or microservice APIs) so migrated and unmigrated journeys stay consistent.
* Perform unit testing before moving code/configuration to QA. Research defects and solve for root cause across WCS, Spring Boot, and Next.js as the defect spans those layers.
* Identify key barriers and core problems; apply problem\-solving skills to complex situations. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a dual\-run architecture (legacy Commerce runtime plus modern storefront).



  





**Skills and Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience (4\+ years professional).
* 5\+ years expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x — store customization, business logic, tools, catalog/order/user flows, and integration with back\-end systems. v8 experience is the hiring bar; later Commerce versions are a plus, not a substitute.
* 5\+ years Java development and OOD skills on large IT systems (J2EE on WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred).
* 3\+ years Spring / Spring MVC; hands\-on Spring Boot (REST APIs, service integration) required — not “Spring on a résumé only.”
* 5\+ years web services (REST and SOAP).
* 5\+ years source control (Git required; SVN/CVS acceptable as prior experience).
* 3\+ years JavaScript, HTML, CSS; Next.js and React experience required (production storefront or equivalent, not tutorials\-only). TypeScript preferred.
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence).
* Strong communication skills; proven team player.



  





**Preferred** 



* B2B commerce, punchout, and/or mobile commerce business models.
* Headless or composable commerce patterns (API\-first storefront consuming Commerce or BFF/microservices). MuleSoft or similar iPaaS is a plus, not required.
* Additional JS frameworks (Angular, Vue) as secondary experience.
* Exposure to search (Solr), session/page cache (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (e.g. Optimizely or equivalent) alongside a commerce engine.
* Experience working Preview vs Runtime (authoring/preview vs customer\-facing) Commerce stacks without treating them as the same environment.

description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Job Summary**
 A Senior Data Platform Engineer with 12\-14 years of experience to own and build the core data platform for a multi\-region CPaaS system supporting multiple digital channels.
   

  

 The platform processes 40,000\+ transactions per second, with multiple ( 10\) state updates per transaction, and powers real\-time metrics, billing, reporting, campaign analytics, and audits.
   

  

 This role is hands\-on and ownership\-driven, focused on data correctness, scalability, and reliability in large\-scale streaming systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Mandatory / Primary Responsibilities
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end data architecture for high\-throughput, event\-driven CPaaS systems.
   

  

 Design state\-transition and event\-sourced data models handling millions of updates per second.
   

  

 Build and operate streaming data pipelines using Apache Pulsar for ingestion and Apache Flink for stateful processing and real\-time aggregation.
   

  

 Design and maintain a data lake using Apache Hudi to support: Upserts and deletes
   

  

 Incremental queries
   

  

 Time\-travel and auditability
   

  

 Build real\-time analytics datasets in ClickHouse for dashboards, tenant metrics, and campaign analysis.
   

  

 Define and enforce processing semantics, including idempotency, deduplication, ordering, and replay safety.
   

  

 Own data correctness, completeness, and freshness SLAs across streaming and analytics systems.
   

  

 Design multi\-region data ingestion and aggregation, including replication, failover, and reprocessing.
   

  

 Lead hands\-on development, code reviews, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 Secondary Responsibilities
   

  

 Mentor senior engineers and review architectural designs.
   

  

 Define data standards, schema evolution practices, and platform guidelines.
   

  

 Participate in release planning and technical prioritization.
   

  

 Evaluate new data technologies and patterns through POCs.
   

  

 Collaborate with product and operations teams on data\-driven features.
   

  

**Skills**
 Mandatory / Primary Skills
   

  

 Apache Pulsar (topics, partitions, subscriptions, geo\-replication)
   

  

 Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, windows, checkpoints)
   

  

 Apache Hudi (Merge\-On\-Read, Copy\-On\-Write, incremental processing)
   

  

 ClickHouse (real\-time analytics, high\-cardinality datasets)
   

  

 Event\-driven and streaming data architectures
   

  

 Event sourcing and state\-transition modeling
   

  

 Idempotent, replay\-safe, and failure\-tolerant data pipelines
   

  

 Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates
   

  

 Multi\-region data design and disaster recovery
   

  

 Secondary Skills
   

  

 Redis for low\-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state
   

  

 PostgreSQL for transactional, relational, and reference data
   

  

 MySQL for operational data stores and legacy integrations
   

  

 Low\-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault\-tolerant components
   

  

 High\-Level Design (HLD) for distributed, multi\-region systems
   

  

 NoSQL stores for hot state (e.g., Mongo, DynamoDB, Cassandra)
   

  

 Relational databases for reference/config data
   

  

 Data lake query engines (Athena, Spark)
   

  

 Observability for data pipelines (lag, freshness, reconciliation)
   

  

 Containerized runtimes and cloud\-native deployments
   

  

 Prior experience with CPaaS, telecom, or large\-scale messaging platforms
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

 12\-14 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems
   

  

 Proven experience building large\-scale, streaming\-heavy data platforms
   

  

 Strong hands\-on background in real\-time analytics and data consistency
   

  

 Comfortable operating at Principal \& Staff Engineer level with full technical ownership

description:
**Job Title: Director\- Software Engineering Lead**
**Job Location: Chennai or Bangalore**
**GCL: F**
**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to set the technical direction for enterprise\-scale AI applications that drive measurable value and improve patient outcomes? In this role, you will provide deep technical leadership for AI\-powered products and platforms, guiding the responsible adoption of Generative AI and machine learning at scale! You will define the architecture, standards, and platform capabilities that multiple product teams rely on to deliver secure, reliable, and cost\-efficient solutions.
   

  

 Do you thrive on influencing sophisticated decisions and uniting product, data, and security collaborators to deliver AI responsibly? You will help build how we turn sophisticated information into practical insights, collaborating across the company to raise quality, accelerate delivery, and embed rigorous governance. Here, ingenuity comes with accountability—innovation is empowered, and following the accurate procedures is non\-negotiable to ensure patient safety and achieve n trust.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 Define and lead a multi\-year technical vision for AI applications and platforms, aligning technology choices to business outcomes and total cost of ownership.
   

  

 Establish and carry out architecture principles, reference designs, and patterns for full\-stack AI solutions (GenAI, ML, data foundations) to ensure reliability, security, and scalability.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership across a portfolio of AI initiatives; review solution designs, mediate trade\-offs, and ensure value delivery through stage gates and measurable objectives.
   

  

 Drive shared components, APIs, model/prompt registries, feature stores, RAG services, and internal developer tooling to accelerate delivery and standardize quality.
   

  

 Lead model selection frameworks, evaluation methods, prompt governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns for LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems.
   

  

 Own technical standards for SLOs, resilience, observability, and cost efficiency; guide guidelines for model and service performance monitoring and continuous improvement in production.
   

  

 Embed security, privacy, and ethical AI principles into building and delivery, including bias testing, explainability, and provenance; collaborate with Security, Legal, and Compliance on governance and audits.
   

  

 Translate strategy into roadmaps and reference implementations with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering; influence adoption through technical guidance rather than line authority.
   

  

 Mentor and upskill senior engineers and technical leads; cultivate communities of practice and technical learning programs to amplify impact.
   

  

 Evaluate and guide strategic technology partners and platforms (cloud, model providers, integration vendors), setting technical guardrails, SLAs, and cost controls.
   

  

 Scan emerging technologies (e.g., multimodal models, agentic workflows, vector databases, privacy\-preserving ML), run targeted pilots, and transition validated innovations into production\-ready standards.
   

  

**Essential Skills/Experience**
* 15\+ years in software/AI engineering with a strong record of technical leadership; experience guiding managers and senior engineers through technical influence rather than formal management.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience); advanced degree preferred.
* Deep experience designing distributed, cloud\-native systems and microservices; strong understanding of data architectures (OLTP/OLAP, streaming, warehousing such as Snowflake) and API ecosystems.
* Confirmed expertise with ML and GenAI solution patterns at scale, including model lifecycle management (training/fine\-tuning, evaluation, drift monitoring), ML Ops, and prompt/guardrail governance.
* Proficiency across modern stacks: Python; JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js; front\-end frameworks (React/Angular/Vue); back\-end (Django/Flask/Fast API); CI/CD; infrastructure\-as\-code; Docker/Kubernetes.
* Significant experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP for secure AI/ML deployments (handled model services, serverless, containers, GPU/accelerator usage, cost optimization).
* Hands\-on familiarity with foundation models and providers (e.g., Open AI, Azure Open AI, Bedrock, Cognitive Services), RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation/guardrail tooling.
* Strong command of software security, privacy\-by\-design, and responsible AI practices; experience embedding controls into delivery processes and succeeding in audits.
* Consistent record to communicate sophisticated technical concepts to executives and non\-technical collaborators; track record of cross\-organizational technical influence and change leadership.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience establishing internal developer platforms, reusable AI components, or model/platform Centers of Excellence.
* Background in enterprise integrations and data engineering (ETL/ELT, streaming, orchestration).
* Familiarity with analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) as part of end\-to\-end product experiences.
* Exposure to regulated environments and model risk frameworks; familiarity with explain\-ability and fairness tooling.
* Experience with cost modeling and Fin Ops practices for AI workloads.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

 Join a place where innovation meets large\-scale impact, and where unexpected teams gather to spark ambitious thinking through challenge. You will work alongside deep specialists who connect across the business to turn sophisticated data into life\-changing insights, advancing our transformation into a digital and data\-led enterprise.  We are seeking an experienced
 **Observability** 
**Platform Manager**

**Job Description Summary**
 As a Lead Controls Engineer specializing in inverter\-based solar and energy storage solutions, you will support the design, implementation, and validation of control systems for inverter products. In this role, you will work as a key technical contributor within the controls team, partnering with cross\-functional teams to develop reliable and effective control solutions that support system performance, safety, and grid integration. This position is intended for an engineer with solid technical experience who can work independently on defined problems and contribute to broader team objectives.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement control strategies for inverter\-based solar and energy storage systems, including coordination with battery management systems (BMS), power conversion systems (PCS), and plant\-level controls.
* Support design, tuning, and testing of inverter control algorithms to meet performance, reliability, safety, and grid compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with systems, software, product, and field teams to clarify requirements and support successful integration of control solutions.
* Perform verification and validation activities for controls functions using standard engineering tools.
* Assist with product and project execution activities from development through commissioning, including troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation such as control logic descriptions, specifications, test procedures, and validation results.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for control\-related issues identified during testing or field operation.
* Work with experienced engineers to improve controls performance, development processes, and product quality.
* Stay informed on applicable industry standards, grid requirements, and control technologies relevant to inverter\-based systems.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field.

* Minimum of 7 to 10 years of working knowledge in power electronics, grid integration fundamentals, and communication protocols such as Modbus and IEC 61850\.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience demonstrating strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience demonstrating ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented, fast\-paced environment.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience with utility\-scale solar or energy storage systems.
* Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or Python.
* Familiarity with applicable industry standards and grid codes such as IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, and UL 9540\.
* Awareness of cybersecurity considerations for control systems.
* Experience supporting commissioning, troubleshooting, or field performance analysis.

title: Software Engineer, Workday
description:
Join us as a Software Engineer, Workday
   

  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
* Day\-to\-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
* It’s a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
* We're offering this role at senior analyst level


 What you'll do
   

  

 In your new role, you’ll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions. You’ll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.

* Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
* Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning

 You’ll need a background in software engineering, software design, architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers. You'll be need experience in understanding business requirements, managing and controlling access to domains and business processes, creating and maintaining security groups, and supporting security governance across the platform.
   

  

 You'll also need practical experience with Workday configurable security and security maintenance, including User\-Based and Role\-Based Security Groups, ISU, and ISSG. Additionally, you'll need exerience in supporting internal and external audit requirements by retrieving Workday evidence, leveraging tools such as Kainos Audit, and ensuring compliance with security and audit standards.
   

  

**You’ll Also Need**
* Experience of working with development and testing tools, bug tracking tools and wikis
* Experience in multiple programming languages or low code toolsets
* Experience of DevOps, Testing and Agile methodology and associated toolsets
* A background in solving highly complex, analytical and numerical problems
* Experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance

* Experience implementing and configuring Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) capabilities for enterprise business requirements.
* Strong experience developing custom Apex classes, triggers, LWC components, Flows, and Salesforce customizations.
* Experience designing and implementing REST API integrations between Salesforce and external applications.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications.
* Good understanding of data migration, data transformation, data validation, and Salesforce data management.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, governor limits, platform limitations, and development best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, version control, deployment processes, testing frameworks, and release management.
* Experience performing code reviews, technical troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and release activities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with architects, functional consultants, QA teams, integration teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver scalable solutions within project timelines.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce platform innovations, AI, integrations, and emerging Salesforce technologies.



  





**Why LevelShift?** 



* Accelerate your career by working on enterprise\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash transformation initiatives for global customers.

 Full\-time
   

  

**Description**
**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
   

  

 Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
   

  

 CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
   

  

 Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

description:
**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior SailPoint Developer** 
 , you will drive the design, development, configuration, implementation, integration, and continuous enhancement of SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions. You will work closely with the Senior SailPoint Engineering Lead and partner with IAM, cloud, infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver scalable and secure identity governance solutions across hybrid, cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in implementing identity governance, lifecycle management, provisioning, access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, cloud identity governance, application onboarding, and automation capabilities. As a highly hands\-on engineering professional, you will contribute to platform modernization, migration initiatives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while leveraging modern identity security practices and cloud\-native governance capabilities.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions.
* Develop and maintain IIQ workflows, lifecycle events, provisioning policies, business processes, rules, forms, reports, customizations, plugins, and application integrations.
* Configure and support ISC sources, access profiles, roles, lifecycle states, identity processing, certifications, provisioning policies, workflows, and event triggers.
* Design, configure, and support Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes across IIQ and ISC environments.
* Implement and support onboarding of enterprise applications, authoritative sources, directories, databases, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
* Develop integrations using REST APIs, Web Services, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, XML, JSON, Java, and BeanShell technologies.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, correlation, reconciliation, and identity data quality processes.
* Design and support automated provisioning and de\-provisioning capabilities across enterprise, SaaS, and cloud environments.
* Support access request, approval, provisioning, certification, role management, entitlement governance, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access review processes.
* Participate in IdentityIQ\-to\-ISC migration initiatives, platform upgrades, modernization programs, testing, release management, and implementation activities.
* Develop automation solutions using Java, BeanShell, PowerShell, Python, APIs, and orchestration capabilities to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, workflow, connector, integration, certification, and performance issues while supporting production environments.
* Prepare technical documentation, deployment guides, runbooks, implementation procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with IAM teams, cloud teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to deliver identity governance solutions.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 6\-10 years of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and application integration experience.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) development experience.
* 2\+ years of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) implementation, configuration, and development experience.
* Experience developing and supporting Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes across IIQ and ISC platforms.
* Experience configuring provisioning, certifications, access request workflows, role management, entitlement governance, and governance controls.
* Experience integrating SailPoint with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, ServiceNow, HR systems, cloud applications, SaaS platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Experience developing REST API, Web Services, and SCIM\-based integrations for identity governance solutions.
* Experience onboarding enterprise applications, authoritative sources, cloud platforms, and SaaS applications into SailPoint.
* Experience supporting identity correlation, aggregation, reconciliation, provisioning, and de\-provisioning automation.
* Experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ upgrades, migrations, patching, and modernization initiatives.
* Experience supporting large\-scale identity governance environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while following established architecture and governance standards.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation discipline, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for delivering secure and scalable identity solutions.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Expertise in SailPoint IdentityIQ Development and Administration.
* Experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) / IdentityNow Development and Administration.
* Strong knowledge of IIQ workflow development including LCM, provisioning, certifications, approvals, rules, forms, reports, and business processes.
* Experience with IdentityIQ customization, rule development, plugin development, and connector configuration.
* Knowledge of ISC workflows, lifecycle states, identity processing, access profiles, roles, certifications, provisioning policies, source onboarding, and event triggers.
* Experience working with Java, BeanShell, REST APIs, Web Services, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP, XML, JSON, SAML, OAuth, and OIDC.
* Experience with identity aggregation, correlation, reconciliation, data quality management, and governance processes.
* Experience integrating with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, GCP, ServiceNow, HR platforms, SaaS applications, and enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of SQL, database development concepts, PowerShell, Python, Git, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
* Understanding of Zero Trust Architecture, Identity Security, Cloud Identity Governance, and IGA best practices.
* SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Certification.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Professional Certification.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Engineer Certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Azure / Entra ID Certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* CompTIA Security\+.
* CISSP or CISM certification.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs

In addition, the team is also responsible for automated updating, configuration, and monitoring of various SAN components in our existing global Ka band network. Team members regularly interact with embedded systems and will need to work closely with the Programmable Logic team and NTN RAN vendor teams in order to support features and required configurations for new devices that are in use.

* Use your experience in O\-RAN based RU M\-plane development and integration of same with other internal RU components
* Integration with other network components (DU, SMO, other SAN/network management applications)
* Design and Implement management applications for Configuring/Updating/Monitoring HW systems
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production \& lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks


**What You'll Need**
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent
* 3\- 5 years of experience working with O\-RAN and 3GPP technology

* Very good understanding of O\-RAN fronthaul/M\-plane specifications
* Demonstrated experience in Network programming and embedded environments

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
 Full\-time
   

  

**Description**
**JOB TITLE: Senior Software Engineer \- AI Platform Engineer**
**JOB TYPE: Full\-Time**
**JOB LOCATION: India, Chennai (Hybrid)**
**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
   

  

 Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
   

  

 CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
   

  

 Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
   

  

 Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re embedding AI across the entire software development lifecycle to reduce the time it takes to understand, triage, and resolve problems \- from planning and code, through CI/CD, to production systems.
   

  

 The AI Foundation team builds the platform infrastructure that makes AI\-assisted software delivery possible inside CloudBees (and our CloudBees Unify product). Our systems ingest signals from pipelines, pull requests, source\-code, tests, and incidents \- and need to process them reliably, at scale, in production.
   

  

 This is a platform engineering role. Your primary identity here is as someone who writes production\-quality Go, operates confidently in Kubernetes\-native environments, and takes observability seriously as a design constraint, not an afterthought.
   

  

 You’ll work in an environment where AI tooling is part of how the team operates \- from development through to the systems we ship. That means being an effective conductor: knowing how to direct AI tooling, decompose problems for it, and apply the same critical judgement to its output that you would to any other contributor’s work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Platform Engineering:**
* Design, build, and operate Go services running on Kubernetes that form the backbone of our agent infrastructure
* Own reliability for production systems \- define SLOs, write runbooks, and be accountable when things go wrong
* Instrument everything: structured logging, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and metrics that surface both system health and the behaviour of the AI workflows running on top
* Contribute to Kubernetes\-native patterns: operators, CRDs, workload isolation, and resource management for dynamic agent workloads
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support rapid, safe iteration \- using AI tooling as a natural part of that workflow


**Engineering in an AI\-Native Environment:**
* Use AI development tooling effectively \- generating, reviewing, and steering code with the same rigour you’d apply to any PR
* Decompose and delegate work to AI agents where appropriate, and know when not to \- catching drift, validating output, and maintaining ownership of outcomes
* Review AI\-generated code with an understanding of its specific failure modes: plausible\-looking but subtly wrong logic, missing edge cases, and over\-confident implementations
* Contribute to the team’s shared judgement on when new models, frameworks, or tooling change the architecture assumptions we’re building on


**Technical Collaboration:**
* Partner with the broader AI Foundation team to establish platform patterns that other teams adopt
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to build vs buy decisions
* Mentor more junior engineers and raise the team’s bar for production readiness and operational discipline


**Working Across Disciplines:**
* You'll work closely with ML engineers and agentic systems engineers on the team, providing the platform foundation \- reliability, observability, deployment infrastructure \- that lets their work reach production safely.
* This is a genuine collaboration: you'll bring rigour to how their systems are built and operated, and they'll bring you along on the AI domain specifics \- model behaviour, context design, evaluation approaches \- as the work demands.
* You won't be expected to arrive knowing that space deeply; you will be expected to engage with it seriously.


**What We're Looking For**
**Required:**
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time operating at senior level
* Strong Go \- idiomatic, well\-tested, production\-shipped (if you meet all the other requirements, but have a different language \- please apply)
* Solid Kubernetes operations experience: you’ve debugged real production incidents, understand the scheduler, and know when a CRD is the wrong answer
* Hands\-on observability experience \- OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, distributed tracing \- and a genuine conviction that unobservable systems are untrustworthy
* Cloud\-native background on AWS or GCP: IAM, managed Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code
* Comfortable working in an AI\-augmented development environment \- directing tools, critically evaluating their output, and maintaining engineering rigour throughout
* Demonstrated ability to own production systems end\-to\-end: design, ship, monitor, iterate


**Preferred:**
* Familiarity with Tekton, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or similar pipeline infrastructure
* Exposure to how LLM\-based systems are structured \- enough to reason about them as infrastructure dependencies, not black boxes
* Experience contributing to platform or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 Months:**
* Shipping production code to the AI Foundation platform with minimal ramp\-up
* Owning at least one service end\-to\-end: SLOs, alerts, and runbooks included
* Identifying and addressing a meaningful observability gap in an existing workflow


**3 \- 6 Months:**
* Delivering a materially improved platform capability that the team relies on
* Contributing patterns or tooling that other engineers adopt
* Being the person teammates reach for on K8s and observability questions


**6 \- 12 Months:**
* Leading a significant platform initiative from design through to production reliability
* Influencing how the team approaches build vs buy vs integrate decisions
* Raising the bar on how the team uses AI tooling in its own engineering practice


**Why This Role**
 Platform engineering here isn’t maintenance work. The systems are genuinely hard \- dynamic workloads, heterogeneous signal sources, reliability requirements that don’t bend because the underlying models are probabilistic.
   

  

 You’ll also be engineering in the way most teams will be working in a few years: AI tooling as a normal part of the workflow, with engineers who know how to get the most out of it without losing ownership of what ships.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role \- Senior Software Engineer** 




**Location: Chennai** 




  





**Want to revolutionise fruit trade in the world?** 




 At Vegrow, we are using technology to transform one of the world's most complex and fragmented agricultural supply chains.
 



 We are building technology across the entire fruit journey — from how we source and move produce to how we monitor, inspect, pack and deliver it. Our engineering teams work across
 **scalable software systems, automation, AI and computer vision** 
 to solve real\-world problems at scale.
 



  





 One of the areas we are actively building is
 **AI\-powered voice automation for our supply operations** 
 . We are building voice agents that can interact with our supply network at scale, automate calling workflows and improve the way we engage with our partners. We are also exploring technologies such as
 **reinforcement learning to make these calling campaigns increasingly intelligent and adaptive** 
 .
 



  





 Alongside this, our broader technology organisation is building computer vision systems for
 **fruit inspection, defect detection, movement monitoring, packing and multi\-object tracking** 
 . These are examples of the kinds of challenging technology problems being solved across Vegrow.
 



 For this role, however,
 **the focus is primarily on building robust software systems and voice\-based applications** 
 . You will work as a hands\-on Senior Software Developer, owning problems end\-to\-end and contributing to the design, development and scaling of the systems that power these products.
 



  





 You do
 **not** 
 need prior experience building voice agents or working with AI. What matters most is strong software engineering fundamentals, the ability to solve complex problems, and the curiosity to learn and work with new technologies. Experience with voice, conversational AI, LLMs or related technologies is a plus.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Senior Software Developer** 
 with 4–5 years of experience who enjoys building production\-grade software and solving challenging technical problems.
 



 You should be comfortable taking ownership of a problem — understanding the requirements, designing a solution, writing clean and maintainable code, testing it, taking it to production and improving it over time.
 



 You will work closely with product, design, QA and business teams, while also contributing to technical design and engineering decisions.
 



  





**Key Role Contours** 



* Design, develop and maintain scalable, reliable and high\-performance software systems.
* Own technically challenging projects from design through development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Contribute to system design, architecture and technical decisions.
* Understand system dependencies, limitations and performance bottlenecks, and design solutions that can scale.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested and production\-ready code.
* Debug complex technical issues and improve system performance, reliability and maintainability.
* Participate actively in code reviews and help maintain strong engineering standards.
* Work closely with product, design, QA and business teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Break down ambiguous problems into well\-defined engineering tasks and provide reasonable estimates and implementation plans.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts where required to validate technical feasibility and reduce risks.
* Document important technical decisions, system designs and engineering practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering processes and system reliability.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions and hands\-on collaboration.
* Stay current with relevant technologies and continuously improve engineering practices.



  





**Voice \& AI Applications** 




 A key area of this role will be the opportunity to work on
 **voice automation and conversational applications** 
 as part of Vegrow's evolving technology stack.
 


* Prior experience building voice agents is a
 **nice\-to\-have, not a requirement** 
 .
* Experience with LLMs, conversational AI, speech technologies, APIs or AI\-powered applications is a plus.
* You may work on building and scaling voice agents and the backend systems that support them.
* You will have the opportunity to learn and work with emerging technologies as these products evolve.



  





**Success Profile** 



* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **4–5 years of professional software development experience.**
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages and modern software development technologies.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming and software engineering principles.
* Good understanding of system design, APIs, databases and building scalable backend systems.
* Experience building and operating production\-grade applications.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring or production systems is a plus.
* Understanding of performance, reliability and observability is desirable.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to take ownership and make sound technical decisions independently.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and work in a fast\-moving environment.



  





**What makes this role exciting?** 




 You will be solving
 **real\-world engineering problems at the intersection of software, automation and AI** 
 , with a direct impact on how fruit moves through India's supply chain.
 



 You will get the opportunity to build systems that interact with people and operations at scale — including
 **voice agents and automation systems** 
 — while working alongside teams building some of Vegrow's broader AI and computer vision capabilities.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native NTN Applications)
description:
**About Us**
 One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards\-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs.
   

  

 RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat’s LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O\-RAN based NTN network – RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc.
   

  

 Team member responsibilities are end\-to\-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration.
   

  

 This is a site‑based role, employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
* Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders.
* Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O\-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects.
* Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
* Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
* Test the applications at various level – unit, module, subsystem, system
* Integration with other network components (DU, CU, RIC, SMO)
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production \& lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale cloud\-native, microservices\-based, event\-driven, distributed applications.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, resiliency, consistency models, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing.
* Experience designing data\-intensive systems using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deep understanding of event\-driven architectures, including asynchronous messaging, event streaming, pub/sub patterns, and event sourcing concepts.
* Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and service\-to\-service communication patterns in distributed environments.
* Proven ability to build highly reliable and observable production systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, disaster recovery, and incident resolution.
* Good understanding of Terrestrial and/or Satellite wireless system, SMO and RIC frameworks


 Technical Expertise:
   

  

* Strong programming skills preferably in Golang or Python
* Containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
* API design and integration, including REST APIs, API versioning, backward compatibility, contract\-first development, API gateways, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and resiliency patterns.
* Event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or equivalent.
* Public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Deployment automation using Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, CloudFormation or similar.


**What Will Help You On The Job**
* Good understanding of O\-RAN specifications, rApps,xApps development
* Hands on development experience with Golang/Python/Rust/Scripting/Cl\-CD in public cloud environment

This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). **Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.

If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!
   

  

 Still hesitating?
   

  

 You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.
   

  

 We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (EaSG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection.
